info.title: Overhead API
info.description: Backend API. Application endpoints return {data, error, request_id} envelopes; device endpoints follow the FlightPortrait protocol wire format.

Location.description: Full location record including private coordinates.

SignedUpload.description: Upload with PUT to signed_url (or uploadToSignedUrl).

ArtAssetUpdate.description: Use /approve and /reject to change review state.

status.description: Setting "ready" verifies the uploaded device binary (size, pixel codes) and records its sha256.

setup_secret.description: Shown once. Enter as the BYOS setup secret during frame provisioning. Only its hash is stored.

DisplayItem.description: One plane in a selection, as the renderer will receive it. No coordinates.

ArtUrls.description: Short-lived signed image links keyed by art asset id.

DisplaySettingsPatch.description: Fields to change; omitted fields keep their current value.

at.description: Evaluate as of this instant (default: now).

CoverageRow.description: Recorded passes grouped by operator + aircraft type, with the best artwork available.

best.description: The best saved photo for an operator + aircraft type slot, and its airframe.

SeenAircraftReport.description: Airframes seen overhead, most-seen first, with pass counts by aircraft type and by operator (top 50 each) over the same filtered passes. `collection` lists every operator + type slot seen (known types only, top 300) with your best photo for it.

recent_routes.description: Up to 3 distinct routes it flew overhead, latest first.

collection_best.description: Your best photo for this airframe's operator + type slot (null when the slot is empty or the type is unknown). It may be of another airframe.

SeenAircraft.description: One airframe seen overhead in the period.

SavedPhoto.description: A photo picked for an airframe. Links only; the image is never downloaded.

PhotoCandidate.description: A photo on offer for an airframe.

status.description: `added`: the operator + type slot was empty and this photo now fills it. `already_best`: it was already the slot's best. `kept_existing`: the slot already has a different best photo (compare them and choose with PUT /photo-collection). `no_type`: the aircraft type is unknown, so there is no slot.

best.description: The best saved photo for an operator + aircraft type slot, and its airframe.

PhotoPickResult.description: A photo picked for an airframe. Links only; the image is never downloaded.

PhotoPick.description: Pick one of the photos listed by the candidates endpoint, by its image_url.

best.description: The best saved photo for an operator + aircraft type slot, and its airframe.

PhotoCollectionSet.description: Make one of your saved photos the best for its operator + type slot.

AircraftPhoto.description: A Planespotters.net photo of the airframe, or null when there is none. Show the photographer and link to page_url; hotlink the image, never store it.

get.summary: Get the caller's profile (created on first access)

get.description: Coordinates are omitted; fetch a single location to see them.

post.summary: Create a location

get.summary: Get a location, including its private coordinates

delete.description: Also deletes its overflights, posters and worker state.

get.description: Filters: registration (prefix), icao24 (exact), type_code (exact), manufacturer and model (substring).

patch.description: Allowed only for aircraft you have observed. Marks metadata_source as "manual" so provider data will not overwrite registration or type.

get.description: Newest first by closest approach. Dates are local to the location. Closest-approach coordinates are omitted unless include_position=true.

get.summary: Sampled track points for an overflight
get.description: Returns private coordinates; ordered by time.
Aggregated by the security-invoker view public.hangar_aircraft, so only your own overflights count.

get.summary: Hangar entry with its most recent passes

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for a source image
post.description: The server chooses the bucket and an owner-prefixed path. Use the returned path as storage_path.

post.summary: Record a source image
post.description: Remote URLs are stored as metadata only; they are never fetched.

delete.summary: Delete a source image and its stored object

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for artwork (or its thumbnail)
Create an art asset record
post.description: New assets start as draft or pending_review.

patch.description: Replacing the image of an approved asset returns it to pending_review.

delete.description: Stored objects are kept; delete them separately if unused.

post.summary: Approve an art asset
post.description: Fails with storage_object_missing unless the image (and thumbnail) exist.

post.summary: Reject an art asset
Create poster metadata
post.description: Rendering is not part of this phase.

get.summary: Get a poster with its items

patch.description: Setting status to "ready" downloads the uploaded device binary, verifies it is a 960,000-byte Spectra 6 panel image and records its sha256. Frames are only ever served verified binaries.

delete.summary: Delete a poster and its items

post.summary: Add overflights to a poster
post.description: Overflights and art assets must belong to you.

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for the frame binary
post.description: Resets the poster to draft (if ready) until the new binary is verified via PATCH status=ready.

post.summary: Register a frame
post.description: Returns a setup secret exactly once. Enter it as the BYOS setup secret when provisioning the frame; only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

delete.description: Its credentials are deleted and its token stops working immediately.

post.summary: Issue a new setup secret (shown once)

revoke_token.description: Also invalidate the current bearer token.

post.summary: Ask the frame to factory-reset on its next wake
post.description: Delivered as reset=true in the next /device/v1/display response; cleared when the frame sets up again.

get.description: Returns 403 for signed-in users who are not admins.

delete.description: You cannot remove your own access.

get.summary: Get a frame with its location rules

patch.summary: Rename a frame, change how often it wakes, or point it at another location
patch.description: location_id must belong to the frame's owner.
Omitted fields keep their current value (or the default, for a frame without settings).

post.summary: Preview what a frame would show
post.description: Runs the same selection as the worker, optionally with draft settings or at another instant, and returns every candidate with its score and why it was or was not picked. Nothing is saved.

patch.summary: Change a location's detection rules (never its coordinates)

post.summary: Create artwork for a user
post.description: storage_path must come from /admin/v1/art-assets/upload-url for the same owner. With approve=true the image must already be uploaded.

post.summary: Signed upload URL for artwork in a user's folder

patch.summary: Change artwork's tags (scope, type, operator, livery, registration, notes)

post.summary: Approve, reject, archive or reopen artwork
post.description: Approval fails with storage_object_missing unless the image (and thumbnail) exist.

get.description: Recorded passes grouped by owner, operator and aircraft type, with the best approved artwork for each group and any drafts waiting for review. Most-seen first.

Recorded passes grouped by airframe, most-seen first, plus pass counts by aircraft type and by operator. `manufacturer` is a comma-separated list of name prefixes, e.g. `airbus,boeing`. `exclude_helicopters` drops types classed as helicopters, and Bell, Eurocopter and Airbus Helicopters aircraft whose type is unknown.

get.summary: Every photo on offer for an airframe
get.description: From Planespotters.net, adsbdb (airport-data.com) and Wikimedia Commons (by registration). Sources that fail are listed in `failed`; the rest still return.

post.summary: Save a photo for an airframe
post.description: image_url must be one of the photos the candidates endpoint lists for this airframe. Saved as a source image (links only). The latest pick is shown on the Aircraft page. When your collection has no photo for the aircraft's operator + type yet, this one fills the slot; otherwise `collection` returns the current best to compare against.

put.summary: Choose the best photo for an operator + type
put.description: Makes one of your saved photos the best for its aircraft's operator + type slot, replacing the slot's current best.

get.description: Looked up on Planespotters.net by Mode S address, then registration, and cached. Fails with not_ready when AIRCRAFT_PROVIDER_USER_AGENT is not set or Planespotters cannot be reached.

get.summary: Reference photos across users, with licence details
Posters across users, with previews and binary status

post.summary: First connected setup (FlightPortrait-compatible, pairing-free BYOS form)

200.description: Fresh bearer token (64 lowercase hex). Only its hash is stored.

401.description: Unknown MAC or wrong setup secret

get.summary: Every wake: current poster binary via short-lived signed URL

503.description: No verified poster binary is available yet; the frame backs off and retries

post.summary: Batched device logs (max 32 entries)
